THE DETAILS MATTER

A responsible partnership.

The proposed commission basis is 15% of eligible product revenue after discounts, excluding tax, shipping, canceled orders, and refunded amounts. No commission is paid for recruitment alone. BKG confirms eligible products, referral attribution, self-purchase rules, payout timing, and payment details in the affiliate agreement before activation.

Affiliates use BKG-approved materials and clearly disclose their affiliate relationship. The LAB products must be represented according to their research-only labeling, without medical, treatment, or human-use claims. Peptides are not endorsed by Brian Gay.
